relationships.evidence_quote: MST quantification revealed a dissociation constant (Kd) of 2.64±0.70 μmol/L for CyRL-QN15-TLR4 binding (Figure 8J)

relationships.subject: CyRL-QN15
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with Vehicle, CyRL-QN15 treatment significantly reduced the expression of MyD88 (0.51-fold), P-IκBα (0.54-fold), and P-P65 (0.65-fold).

relationships.subject: CyRL-QN15
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunofluorescence staining on days 3 and 8 revealed that CyRL-QN15 significantly down-regulated IL-1β and TNF-α expression while up-regulating IL-10 expression

key_findings: CyRL-QN15 accelerates rat oral ulcer healing and is the first ultra-short cyclic peptide TLR4 antagonist
Met6 is critical for TLR4 binding (CYM3 35-fold lower affinity)
